Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form redlines — publicity carveouts

Sergio —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached are our redlines to the MSA and the Order Form. Two items where we need specific carveouts so we can get procurement and comms aligned:

1) Publicity / press release language: We are open to a limited announcement once the product is live, but we need an embargo period and a narrow scope (no use of our logo in third-party paid media, only the press release and partner page).

2) Confidential information carveouts: our legal wants an explicit clause that allows non-confidential, non-identifiable metrics to be quoted in aggregated case studies — but only if anonymized.

We flagged these in the Word redline (attachment). Can you propose alternative phrasing that would be acceptable to Redwood? If we can align on short, specific language we can avoid escalating to our GC.

Attachment: ProspectCo_MSA_Redlines_20280921.docx (tracked changes)

—Emily

legal@prospectco.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <legal@prospectco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form redlines — publicity carveouts

Emily —

Thanks for sending the redlines. Quick read-through below and proposed edits inline (high level first):

- Embargo window: we propose a 60-day embargo after a mutually agreed product launch date. This gives both teams time for PR coordination and avoids surprise mentions.
- Logo use: we can allow logo use on Redwood’s Partner Page and in one (1) public press release with prior written approval. No use in paid ads or third-party vendor co-branded collateral without separate license.
- Case study / metrics: allow anonymized aggregate metrics (e.g., % latency improvement across customers) but not customer-identifiable performance numbers unless Customer provides written consent.

Suggested clause (draft language):
"Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive right to: (i) include Customer's name and logo on Redwood's Partner Page and in one public press release announcing the deployment; and (ii) reference anonymized, aggregated performance metrics, provided such metrics cannot reasonably be used to identify Customer. Any other use of Customer's logo or individualized performance data requires Customer's prior written consent."

If that reads OK to you, we’ll incorporate into the MSA redline and circulate for signature. Monica — can you confirm marketing timing and whether we have an approved logo asset package to share once they sign? Karthik — flagging for Legal/Sales alignment on the deal economics if we have to include a case study incentive.

Attachment: (proposed snippet included inline)

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
